posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
Dolphins star RB De’Von Achane suffered a torn ACL, sources tell me and Adam Schefter, and he’s out for the season.

In an already trying season for Miami, the team loses Achane.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Baker Mayfield is still expected to miss some time, as he'll need to be able to grip a ball. Jalon Daniels will start going forward, but Mayfield's good news helps him back on the field sooner.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Sources: Bucs QB Baker Mayfield suffered a dislocated thumb but got good news on the MRI. No fracture and no ligament or tendon damage.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
Sources: Panthers star CB Jaycee Horn suffered a torn quad and is out indefinitely. One of the game's best. 

Horn will seek a second opinion, but he's headed for Injured Reserve and could be lost for the season.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Panthers Pro Bowl CB Jaycee Horn is out indefinitely after suffering a quad injury in Sunday’s loss to the Browns, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

Horn is seeking a second opinion. But he’s likely to land on injured reserve and miss significant time.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Bucs QB Baker Mayfield underwent tests that showed no fracture and no tendon or ligament damage in his right thumb, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports. 

Mayfield will need to regain strength after Sunday’s dislocation and likely will miss some time. But good news overall.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
By trading J.J. McCarthy now, the Vikings save over $4.6M in cash and cap space and get an unconditional fifth-round pick in the next draft that, depending how the Giants finish, could end up being a top-150 selection.

Meanwhile, New York adds another former first-round pick QB.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Trade! The Vikings are sending QB J.J. McCarthy to the Giants for a 2027 fifth-round pick, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

With Jaxson Dart out for the regular season, New York adds another young QB, while Minnesota gains flexibility and McCarthy gets a fresh start.
